arguments.sql: SELECT id, date, errors FROM transactions WHERE errors IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id
arguments.explanation: Lists the id, date and error of every transaction that has a recorded error, in id order.
assumptions: 'Had an error' means transactions.errors is not NULL; any of the seven error types counts.
No date filter applied, so the full data range 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31 is included.
Rows are ordered by transaction id so the output order is stable.
